The '''observation droid''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] which saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was capable of speech to relay messages and was employed by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]], as well as by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].

==History==
{{Quote|Send out the probes. I want them found now!|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>}}
After [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived on the planet Zygerria to find the missing [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], Skywalker got into a dispute with [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of Zygerria, [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]], after Ahsoka prevented him from whipping one of his [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

Skywalker then told the Zygerrian that he had news about [[Bruno Denturri/Legends|Bruno Denturri]] for the queen, [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]], but the Zygerrian did not believe him. As the Zygerrian wanted to punish Skywalker, a [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droid]] intervened and told them to cease all hostilities and escort the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the queen.

These probe droids were used in the search for Ahsoka Tano after she escaped from prison to the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. They were carried on the [[Republic police gunship/Legends|Republic police gunships]] used in the search, and when Anakin Skywalker saw Tano and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] running away from him on [[Terminal 24/Legends|terminal 24]], he sent several droids after the pair to find them. Later, one droid identified Tano while she was using a public communicator box on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]]. It relayed her location to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] who tried to arrest her with several members of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. Tano, however, escaped from them.

These droids were also used as security by the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] on their homeworld [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] at their palace when Skywalker and Kenobi visited the Pykes to [[Mission to Oba Diah (Sifo-Dyas)|investigate]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas's]] [[Death/Legends|death]]. One followed the Jedi and [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] as he lead them to a cell where [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]'s personal aide [[Silman/Legends|Silman]] was. A probe alerted two [[Pyke guard/Legends|Pyke guards]] of [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]'s [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]] coming to the place and when Dooku killed the two guards, this alerted the Pykes of his arrival.
